lines.en: I move forward carrying my shell.
My shell scrapes softly on the ground.

lines.zh: 我把两根触角伸出去又收
lines.en: I extend two tentacles and draw them in.
I crawl over a wet leaf.

lines.zh: 我身后有一条淡淡的亮痕
lines.en: A faint bright line trails behind me.
I stop and my shell rocks.

lines.zh: 我翻过一颗小石子，很费劲
lines.en: I struggle over a small pebble.
I make my way slowly along the wall's base.
There is old mud on my shell.
I measure the road step by step.

lines.zh: 我的身体从壳里伸出一半
lines.en: Half my body shows from the shell.

lines.zh: 我从一片叶背爬到叶面
lines.en: I climb from a leaf's underside to its face.

lines.zh: 我经过一颗露水，停了一下
lines.en: I pass a dewdrop and pause.

lines.zh: 我把身体伸得更长一点
lines.en: I stretch my body a little longer.
I climb along a crack in the stone.
A little water has collected in my shell.

lines.zh: 我缩在壳里，只露出一截
lines.en: I sit in my shell, only a part showing.
My shell's mouth faces a leaf.
I am waiting for rain.
I retreat into my shell to wait out the rain.

lines.zh: 太阳有点大，我往阴里挪
lines.en: The sun is strong; I move into shade.

lines.zh: 我爬过的地方留一道亮。
lines.en: I leave a bright trail where I crawl.
A bug crawls over my shell.
I draw my body deeper in.

lines.zh: 壳口有一层薄薄的水光
lines.en: A thin film of water shines at my shell's mouth.
I point my tentacles two ways.

lines.zh: 一片落叶慢慢落在我壳上
lines.en: A fallen leaf settles on my shell.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把身体转了半圈
lines.en: I turn my body half a round.
Water runs past the base of the wall.
I lift my shell slightly.
I count the falling drops.

lines.zh: 有只蚂蚁在我前面停住
lines.en: An ant stops ahead of me.
I come out of my shell to look at you.
You do not look like someone who would step on me.

lines.zh: 我的触角碰到你的影子就收
lines.en: My tentacles shrink at your shadow.
Will you crouch a little?
I am at your feet, quite safe.
My shell turns.
I turn both tentacles toward you.
Your shoe is right beside me.
I retreat slowly under the leaf.

lines.zh: 我看不清你，只能感到影子
lines.en: I cannot see you, only feel your shadow.

lines.zh: 你不要动脚，我还没过去
lines.en: Do not move your foot; I am not past yet.
I turn my shell's mouth your way.
I withdraw, and my shell sits crooked.
There is a new mark on my shell.
I stay in a long while.
I slowly right myself.
I lean my shell against a stone.
I stay drawn in, unmoving for a long while.
My shell's mouth faces down.
I slowly come out again.
Both my tentacles have gone limp.
I stop at the end of my trail.
I will drink a little of the water on the leaf.
There is damp on your hand.
I am in no hurry; I crawl slowly.

lines.zh: 你把东西放到地上就好
lines.en: Just set it on the ground.
I probe with a tentacle first.
I drink the water on the leaf, slowly.
Your hand is held too high.
I extend half my body to try.
This is enough to last me all day.
I will not snatch; I will just wait.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的手边爬上去
lines.en: I crawl up the edge of your hand.
This smells of rain.
I stop and take one sip.

lines.zh: 我要在那片叶上待一会
lines.en: I want to stay on that leaf a while.
My tentacle touches you.

lines.zh: 我的触角已经伸过去了
lines.en: My tentacles have already reached it.
You step by my side and the earth sinks.
The knock sends me into my shell.

lines.zh: 我的壳在你鞋上碰了一下
lines.en: My shell taps your shoe.
I roll half over, shell mouth down.

lines.zh: 我停在你留下的脚印里
lines.en: I stop in the print you left.
My shell meets your toe.

lines.zh: 我被你的影子一惊，缩了
lines.en: Your shadow startles me in.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，壳转了向
lines.en: We bump and my shell turns.
I roll half a turn by your foot.

lines.zh: 你踩到的土把我顶偏了
lines.en: The ground you press shoves me aside.
Her shell is rounder than mine.
Our shell mouths face each other.

lines.zh: 我们的触角轻轻碰了一下
lines.en: Our tentacles touch lightly.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后爬过叶子
lines.en: We cross the leaf one behind the other.
There is an old mark on her shell.

lines.zh: 我们一起把触角伸出来
lines.en: We both extend our tentacles.
She stops at the rim of my shell.

lines.zh: 我们慢慢往上爬同一根杆
lines.en: We climb the same stalk, slowly.

lines.zh: 她的痕迹和我的并成一条
lines.en: Her trail and mine join into one.

lines.zh: 我们在同一片叶子下躲
lines.en: We shelter under the same leaf.

lines.zh: 我把身体探过去，用触角碰
lines.en: I reach out and touch it with a tentacle.
It is smaller than I am.
I try touching it with my mouth.
It sticks to my side.
I carry it a short way.
I loop my body around it.

lines.zh: 我用触角把它拨了一下
lines.en: I nudge it with a tentacle.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里试了试
lines.en: I hold it in my mouth to test it.
It catches on my shell's mouth.

lines.zh: 我带着它往叶子那边爬
lines.en: I crawl toward the leaf with it.
I stop and my tentacles withdraw.
I turn my shell's mouth toward you.
I am slow, but I will not leave.
I align my shell's mouth.
My tentacles withdraw and extend again.
I shift a little your way.
My shadow lies by your foot.
I turn my shell opening toward you.
I stop, and my shell stops too.
I do not know what you intend.
I inch along, my shell rocking.

lines.zh: 我身后的痕一直连到你脚边
lines.en: My trail runs to your feet.
I creep along the edge of the leaf.
I keep crawling your way.
I stop on the earth you trod.
My trail draws nearer and nearer.
One step back for you is far for me.
I crawl under a blade of grass.
When you move, I follow a stretch.
I never change direction.
I bump you with my shell.
I extend my body and push.

lines.zh: 我这一点力气挡不住谁
lines.en: My strength stops no one.
I strike and withdraw into the shell.
I push my shell at you.
I reach my body to your foot.

lines.zh: 我这一点力气，你也知道
lines.en: You know how little strength I have.
I strike and pull in.
My tentacles touch your hand.
I push my body toward you.
I come out of the wet moss.
Water still clings to my shell.
I put out tentacles to test the way.
A faint line appears on the ground.
I slowly draw my body out.
My shell's mouth shows first.
I test my tentacles.

lines.zh: 我从一片苔的边缘出现
lines.en: I appear at the edge of the moss.
I slowly extend my body.
I stop on a wet stone.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的身体干得发紧
lines.en: Fire dries my body tight.

lines.zh: 我从叶子上滚下去，壳先着地
lines.en: I roll off the leaf, shell first.
Too much water; I cannot right myself.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的壳掀得翻了面
lines.en: The blast flips my shell over.

lines.zh: 有东西打在壳上，声音很闷
lines.en: Something hits the shell, dull and heavy.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我一直缩着
lines.en: That force keeps me drawn in.
I shrink in my shell, lighter and lighter.

lines.zh: 雷光一亮，我整个缩进去了
lines.en: Lightning flashes and I pull all the way in.

lines.zh: 地面没了，我带着壳往下落
lines.en: The ground is gone; I fall with my shell.
